dialogueEntries.text: That's different. The person next to you is actually here.
He's... actually kind of cute.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Alright class, welcome to your World History class!

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: My name is Dr. Nelson! It's a pleasure to meet you all.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Before we begin, I’d like for you all to introduce yourself to your neighbors. Don’t be shy, these will be your assigned seats for the rest of the semester!
The boy turns to look at you and smiles.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Black-Haired Boy
dialogueEntries.text: Hey. I'm Ash. What's your name?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Ayla.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: That's a cool name, I haven't heard it before.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Thanks. My dad chose it for me.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: So I haven't seen you around. What middle school did you go to?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Freedom Middle.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: That makes sense, I went to Stonewater. That's probably why I haven't seen you around.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: What other classes do you have today?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: PE, my music class, and then math.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Oh, cool! We'll be in the same PE block then! If I'm being honest, though, I can't say I'll enjoy it...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Me neither... they always act so serious, like it's a military boot camp or something.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Really, though. I mean, seriously, I didn't know I was getting drafted.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Yeah... I'm more of a music and arts person myself. I don't really like sports.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Same, for sure. Oh, that reminds me, I have music class after PE too! What class is it exactly?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Advanced Guitar.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Really? Me too! I guess we'll be seeing a lot of each other this school year.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Alright class, settle down! Now that you know a bit about each other, let me tell you a bit about myself.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: I have a PhD in History from Carnegie Mellon University, and I've been teaching for over 20 years.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Now, I love this subject, and I have a tendency to go off on tangents. So I ask that you all please keep my time conscious if that happens. I want to make sure we get through the material.
Ash is scribbling something in his notebook. He slides it over to show you a note.
Read it?
Read it?
It reads: if he went to Carnegie Mellon, why is he teaching in this shithole?
You laugh a little at the note.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: My favorite period of history? I'm not sure I can pinpoint just one period, but I have always found the Peloponnesian War to be fascinating. It's fascinating what it did for language development.
He passes another note: god he is sooo boring...

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Is that note passing I see back there?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Uhh... yes...?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: If you two don't want to start failing the class, I suggest you build good habits. And that starts with paying attention.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ash
dialogueEntries.text: Sorry sir, won't happen again.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: And you, miss?

dialogueEntries.speaker: Ayla
dialogueEntries.text: Yes sir, I apologize.

dialogueEntries.speaker: Teacher
dialogueEntries.text: Hmph. Well, as I was saying...
Ash seems to surveil the teacher, waiting for the right moment to write another note.
He taps his notebook discretely. It reads: talk later? write me ur number? ;p
You catch his eye. He smiles and winks at you.
You smile back and write it, trying not to ignore the way your face feels red.
He hums contentedly. Your mind is racing.
What the HELL is happening...
You push it away, and the teacher continues his lecture. He doesn't try again.
The rest of the class goes by uneventfully.
The rest of the class goes by uneventfully.
